content: PlanningListVariable models ordered sequences (e.g. vehicle visit routes); chained variables (@AnchorShadowVariable + previousStandstill pattern) are the older, pre-list-variable mechanism for the same kind of routing/chain problem, largely superseded by list variables for new designs. Neither models 'one shift envelope per agent-day plus an independent per-slot seat variable' -- that shape is better served by two independent @PlanningEntity classes with plain @PlanningVariable fields joined via ConstraintStream, not by a list or chain.
